implementation_choices.IC-01: Each seed stream yields, per family in class order (asset, period) then family index: the secret draw (rip1_attack.draw: c, a, b, m), then tau (randint 128..384, drawn in every world so streams align), then the n standard-normal draws of each member in member order.
implementation_choices.IC-02: Seed 5103 gives the planted U-vol/U-event world (shift) and, from the SAME normal draws without the shift, the planted U-act world (= RIP-1 world). Seed 5104 gives the null U-vol/U-event world (no shift) and, from the same draws with act = 0, the null U-act world. Paired worlds per seed.
implementation_choices.IC-03: Δ one-hot (3 tick values) appended to the A1/A2/A4 feature vector when Δ is shown; standardised with the other columns. A3 never sees Δ.
implementation_choices.IC-04: A6 component ablation is computed in every scenario (ind, g4, g16); the design does not restrict it.
implementation_choices.IC-05: Feature-group ablation and permutation importance are computed in C2 with Δ hidden (the operational case); the design does not name the condition. Groups follow the reid.features docstring.
implementation_choices.IC-06: U-event: σ̂_s is the population standard deviation (ddof = 0) of s_t, t = 1..511.
implementation_choices.IC-07: Bootstrap index sets: numpy default_rng(5201), drawn per scenario in the order ind, g4, g16, B sets each, stratified by class; the same sets serve every compared condition and the utility measures (ind).
implementation_choices.IC-08: Permutations: numpy default_rng(5202), drawn in the order scenario × representation × group × repeat (the loop order of run() and _feature_groups(); tested).
implementation_choices.IC-09: A6 under C0 and under C1 for affine_level (a = 1, b = 0, so x = P) use the price likelihood (lognormal P_0 around Lg, Gaussian log returns, Jacobians); C1 tick_grid uses c = 0 and C1 level_residual uses m = 100 x tick_k of the CLASS, no integration.
implementation_choices.IC-10: Within-Δ-group results use the Δ-shown predictions; the group-pooled-prior variant differs from AP only for tick_grid in C2 (c prior), and is computed only there; elsewhere it is reported as identical.
implementation_choices.IC-12: level_residual likelihood: the wrapped-normal sum is computed exactly for every increment — dual (Poisson summation) series when S/m > 0.5, otherwise the direct sum centred on the nearest image. The RIP-1 code centres the direct sum on j = 0 and drops mass for large |d| (FL-023); RIP-2 uses the exact sum (tested against a brute-force wide sum). The support of the transform, x in [0, m), is enforced (FL-024).
implementation_choices.IC-11: Development families use seed 5101 + 1000·g and evaluation families 5102 + 1000·g (g = 1, 4, 16), so the scenarios do not share paths; utility families use 5103 / 5104 directly (S-ind only).
